column2: agreed drop as garbled, but forms are ware/warden/wares: looks like Ware (merge:Ware) or English ware/warden; re-examine
agreed merge:sozial, but forms are the English word social (social start-up, social media): English look-alike, likely drop
agreed merge:blau, but forms are blue/blu/blues: English look-alike (Blu-ray, blue), likely drop
agreed merge:Trade, but forms are English trades/trad: check whether Trade is a listed German loan or this is English, drop
agreed merge:Champagner, but Champagne is the French region (place name not on list -> drop) and the French word; check examples
agreed merge:fidel, but examples are Fidel Castro: person name -> drop unless the adjective dominates
agreed merge:unterliegen, but the form is far more likely the noun Unterlagen (documents) -> merge:Unterlage
agreed merge:werten, but 'werte' is mostly the noun plural Werte or the address 'werte Kunden' (wert); re-examine target
agreed merge:tun, but Zutun is kept as its own noun in this round (ohne mein Zutun) -> merge:Zutun?
agreed keep as noun 'ein Zuviel', but forms are lower-case zuviel (old spelling of zu viel); re-examine
agreed keep as 'das Unbewusste', but the capitalised adjective rule says merge:unbewusst (the noun would be Unbewusste); re-examine
